description:
Outcome: After first-version acceptance, teacher sees overdue outstanding loans, from original owner requirement explicitly deferred by latest instruction: Defer the overdue list to after the first version.
Scope: Overdue query and accessible UI with book, pupil label and due date; oldest-due ordering, catalogue navigation to existing return controls, injectable local calendar clock. Excludes: first-version delivery, reminders, fines and separate return flow.
Acceptance: Include outstanding loans due before local today; exclude due today/future and returned loans. Clear empty view; refreshing after return clears entry.
Behaviour: Safe labelled keyboard-accessible list/navigation, loading/error/retry.
Verification: node:test date/month/year boundaries and returned-loan filtering, plus manual keyboard and return/refresh journey. Run only in later milestone. Prerequisites: B1 loan API, A2 catalogue UI, C3 first-version acceptance. C3 is an explicit owner-defined release boundary, not automatic phase chaining. Assumptions: local calendar overdue semantics.
Setup alias: B3. Deferred: after first version.
title: Deferred: overdue query and display
